title: The Council of Nine
summary: The Avatar of the Council grows weaker as its nine council members join the battle.
overview: The Avatar of the Council grows weaker as its nine council members join the battle.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Each ten-percent health step from 90% through 10% activates another council member and sends it against a random target on the Avatar’s hate list.
The Avatar’s melee damage falls at each activation, but the raid must handle the accumulating council members. Assign pickup tanks before the next health push.
Avoid pushing several thresholds faster than the raid can establish control of the newly active enemies.
Leaving combat fully heals the Avatar, restores its original damage and rebuilds the council population.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
